nodes.title: Refactor APIs to use frame tokens
nodes.body:
### Confirmation

- [x] I am a [maintainer](https://github.com/orgs/electron/people) of the Electron project. (If not, please create a [different issue type](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/new/).)

### Description

Frame routing IDs were recently removed from the renderer process upstream. We should refactor frame-related APIs to use frame tokens instead.

Related:
- https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/47616
- https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/47717
- https://github.com/electron/electron/pull/47850

## WebContents

- [ ] 'did-fail-load' event
- [ ] 'did-fail-provisional-load' event
- [ ] 'did-frame-finish-load' event
- [ ] 'did-frame-navigate' event
- [ ] 'did-navigate-in-page' event

Events which pass in `frameProcessId` and `frameRoutingId` as a parameters should be redesigned to set them as properties on the `Event` object. See past work in https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/37085

Where possible, a `WebFrameMain` instance as a `frame` property should be preferred over individual frame identifier properties.

## Webview

- [ ] 'will-frame-navigate' event
- [ ] 'did-start-navigation' event
- [ ] 'did-redirect-navigation' event
- [ ] 'did-frame-navigate' event

These use `frameRoutingId` as a parameter. If we are to replace this parameter, it will need to go through a breaking change in a major release.

nodes.body:

### Electron Version

37.2.3

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

Ubuntu 22.04

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

6.1.12

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

Expect the webSocket request made from the service worker to be handled by `onBeforeSendHeaders`:
```
Electron v37.2.3 started.
onBeforeSendHeaders webSocket wss://127.0.0.1/renderer/ws
onBeforeSendHeaders webSocket wss://127.0.0.1/service-worker/ws
```

### Actual Behavior

`onBeforeSendHeaders` does not get called when making a websocket request from a service worker:
```
Electron v37.2.3 started.
onBeforeSendHeaders webSocket wss://127.0.0.1/renderer/ws
```

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/RitvarsZ/1529b1c9c3af90996c6d93022484a63e

### Additional Information

Also checked `onBeforeRequest` and `onSendHeaders` - ws request was missing. Applying filters like `<all_urls>` or `wss://*/*` also does not help.

This issue also applies to extension service workers.

nodes.title: Introduce the window.beginDrag() function to trigger native window dragging
nodes.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a feature request that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Problem Description

Modern browsers such as Chrome allow users to drag tabs out of the main window to create new ones, providing a seamless, OS-integrated window dragging experience. In Electron, replicating this behavior is currently not possible using native APIs.

When implementing a similar feature (dragging a tab to create a new window), developers must simulate dragging by:

- Listening to mouse events in the original window.
- Creating a new BrowserWindow.
- Manually updating its position based on mouse movements.

This approach is:

**Non-performant** on low-end systems or virtual machines.
**Incompatible with OS-native behaviors** like window snapping, drag previews, or aero shake.
**Complex** to implement and maintain.

### Proposed Solution

Introduce a `window.beginDrag()` (or similar) method on BaseWindow that programmatically initiates native window dragging behavior, as if the user clicked and dragged the title bar.

**Example usage:**

```typescript
const newWin = new BaseWindow({ /* options */ });
newWin.beginDrag(); // Starts native drag immediately
```

This API should:

- Begin an OS-native drag for the given window.
- Respect platform-specific behaviors (snapping, animations, etc.).
- Optionally accept mouse position offsets.

### Alternatives Considered

**Alternatives Considered**
- **Manual window repositioning** using `win.setBounds()` or `win.setPosition()`:
Works but lacks OS integration and performs poorly on some environments.

- **Transparent windows with drag regions**:
Fragile and limited; doesn't cover the use case where a new window is created and dragged.

- **Simulating drag using drag-and-drop APIs**:
Not intended for window control; only handles DOM elements.

### Additional Information

**Prior Art**
- Neutralino.js introduced this functionality in its latest release with window.startDrag(), improving UX for lightweight desktop apps.
- Chrome and other browsers have long supported native tab detaching with drag behaviors.

- Neutralino.js introduced this functionality in its latest release with window.startDrag(), improving UX for lightweight desktop apps.
- Chrome and other browsers have long supported native tab detaching with drag behaviors.

Windows ### Operating System Version win10 ### What arch are you using? x64 ### Last Known Working Electron version 最新 ### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome? No ### Expected Behavior 标题 Electron 渲染进程无法捕获右键菜单事件（Windows，React 项目） 系统环境 操作系统：Windows 10 Electron 版本：37.2.3 Node.js 版本：v24.4.0 前端框架：React + Vite 现象描述 在浏览器环境下，右击悬浮球组件可以正常弹出自定义菜单栏并输出日志。 在 Electron 桌面环境下，右击悬浮球完全没有任何反应，控制台没有“右键菜单触发”日志，菜单栏也不显示。 已尝试升级/降级 Electron，关闭杀毒软件、输入法、桌面管理工具，重启电脑，均无效。 Electron 主进程窗囗配置已尝试(] frame: true/false,transparent:true/false,alwaysonTop:true,均无效。 代码片段如下： // App.jsx import React from 'react'; import FloatingTimer from '../components/FloatingTimer'; export default function App() { return (
); } // FloatingTimer.jsx（核心部分）
{/* ... */}
期望结果 Electron 桌面环境下，右击悬浮球能正常弹出自定义菜单栏，并在控制台输出日志。 ### Actual Behavior 鼠标右击悬浮球组件,菜单栏未弹出,控制台也没有生成日志 ### Testcase Gist URL _No response_ ### Additional Information 浏览器环境下完全正常，只有 Electron 环境下无效。

### Electron Version

35.7

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Ubuntu

### Operating System Version

Ubuntu 24.04

### What arch are you using?

x64

### Last Known Working Electron version

_No response_

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

No

### Actual Behavior

This code:
```js
const webContents = this.webContentsView.webContents;

console.log("webContents.isDestroyed():", webContents.isDestroyed());
console.log("webContents.isDevToolsOpened()", webContents.isDevToolsOpened());
```

Results in:
```
webContents.isDestroyed(): false
<crash>
```

The original code was more like this: `if (!webContents.isDestroyed() && webContents.isDevToolsOpened()) {..}`, and crashes as well. 

The underlying web Contents has likely called "window.close()". 

Its called from an "blur" event listener:
```js
webContentsView.webContents.on("blur", () => {..});
```


### Expected Behavior

It should not crash..

### Testcase Gist URL

https://gist.github.com/b797e4f192345ed19276e39a3bc72ac5

### Additional Information

_No response_

nodes.title: Add Icelandic spell check support
nodes.body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project.
- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a feature request that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Problem Description

When I type in Icelandic in [obsidian](https://obsidian.md/) then I get a lot of red squiggly error lines below the words since obsidian doesn't support Icelandic for spell checking.
According to [this post](https://forum.obsidian.md/t/icelandic-spellcheck/39062/2) on the obsidian forums from 2022 then "We use the spellchecker provided by electron which in turn uses chrome or macos’ spellchecker. IF they have it, we have it, If they don’t we don’t. Nothing we can do about it." which is why I post this here.

The only other issue I found about this by searching "icelandic" was [this one](https://github.com/electron/electron/issues/586) but it is very different.

### Proposed Solution

I have 2 ideas for a solution but all of them are to add Icelandic as a spell check languages.

1. Find a language pack online and add it. I found these potential sources:
     - From Árnastofnun: http://www.bin.arnastofnun.is (They have a CC BY-SA 4.0 license)
     - From Microsoft: https://www.microsoft.com/is-is/download/details.aspx?id=51200 (Unsure about licensing but microsoft points to [this page](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/legal/terms-of-use))
     - From Aspell: http://aspell.net/ which I learned about from [here](https://harabanar.com/2010/02/09/villuleit-a-islensku-i-wordpress/) About the license, I didn't see which one they use but they do say it is "Free and Open Source"
     - From libreoffice: https://extensions.libreoffice.org/en/extensions/show/hunspell-is-the-icelandic-spelling-dictionary-project Which I learned about from [here](https://github.com/recette-lemon/vim-spell-is) which seems to use [CC-BY](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) license

2. Make a new language pack by having people add it to the language pack directly through obsidian. This sounds like a lot more work but is a real solution.

I lean most towards using idea 1.

### Alternatives Considered

I have considered and currently am using the method of adding every single Icelandic word and inflection of each word to the english dictionary that is already in use in obsidian.
This is very tedious and quite boring but it does work.

### Additional Information

Obsidian version 1.8.10
